method.source: Pinned Git blobs for every own/dependency module, not live working-tree sources.
method.grammar: Strip nested block and line comments, then parse only leading module/prelude/import lines, including public/private/meta/all import modifiers and multiple module names.
method.count: Deduplicated explicit transitive header-import modules, including each named root; report project/Mathlib/Quantum/other-package providers separately.
method.boundary: Stop at explicit Lean, Init, Std, Lake imports and list them; do not follow toolchain source edges or add implicit prelude imports.
method.meaning: Deterministic source import-footprint evidence only; not declaration reachability, olean size, loaded runtime memory, or timing improvement.
method.unsupported_imports: Any unparsed header import is fatal; unresolved non-toolchain imports or ambiguous reachable providers make complete false.
